items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Yeah, I recorded some records with him three or four years ago.

ctx.x: Well, I did, but I wasn't too successful with it. I think I waited a little too late for that. So you've always used the pick? I've always used the pick. The pick style. I would like to study it, but if I had, you know, time to put it into it. Maybe I could, you know, do a little stuff. Did you, uh, like the guitar.

I mentioned before, we started the tape that Johnny St. Cyr mentioned that he thought you had such a wonderful style on your solos and all, that if he ever had a band, he'd like to play the rhythm guitar himself and have you as a featured soloist on guitar.
Yeah, I recorded some records with him three or four years ago.
